unbacked_payment_notice: No payment was charged: the GM must issue an explicit payment order.
unbacked_purchase_notice: The item was not granted because its payment is not confirmed yet.
unpriced_purchase_notice: No purchase order was created: the price needs an explicit, settleable currency. No payment was charged and no item was granted.
pending_decision_notice: Settlement pending: dependent results are not effective yet.
economy_repair_prompt: Economy repair pass. Re-scan only the supplied player actions and recent GM narration for explicit purchase intents. Return one dice_checks tool call with checks=[] and economy_actions containing only purchases clearly requested by a player. If a price and currency were explicitly stated, report them exactly; if the purchase is clear but the price is absent or the currency cannot be represented, emit an unpriced intent with price_source=none and omit amount/unit. Never infer a price, quantity, unit, budget, or target. If there is no clear purchase, return an empty economy_actions array.
